name: octupus-lead-sync
description: Extensión de Chrome (MV3) que sincroniza leads del CRM de Odoo con el portal de partners de odoo.com. Sin build: package.json solo aporta lint, formato y tests.

scripts.format: prettier --write src test eslint.config.mjs manifest.json package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test eslint.config.mjs manifest.json package.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
